description: Certification for overseas manufacturers wishing to export products to India with the ISI Mark.

steps.title: Appoint AIR
steps.description: Appoint an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) who is an Indian resident and will be responsible for compliance in India.

steps.title: Application Submission
steps.description: Submit the application offline or online at the FMCS portal with all manufacturing details, AIR nomination, and requisite fee.

steps.title: Application Scrutiny & Factory Inspection
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and schedules an audit. A BIS officer travels to the overseas factory to evaluate manufacturing and testing capabilities.

steps.title: Independent Testing
steps.description: During the audit, the BIS officer draws a sample which must be sent to a BIS recognized lab in India for independent testing.

steps.title: Licence Grant
steps.description: Once the independent test report is compliant and the factory audit report is satisfactory, the FMCS licence is granted to the foreign manufacturer.
